title: FitReceipt
tagline: A garment try-on with consent and a reviewable task record.
inspiration: A virtual garment preview should make image handling and the limits of the result clear to the shopper.
whatItDoes: Collects explicit image consent, uploads permitted photos directly through signed provider URLs, creates and polls a YouCam cloth-v4 task, and saves a workspace-owned receipt that can be removed locally.
howItWasBuilt: Next.js routes hold the YouCam credential on the server. Short-lived ownership tokens bind uploaded assets to the requesting workspace. PostgreSQL stores task records, while the browser handles the signed image transfer and preview.
technicalEvidence: Vercel hosting and the configuration endpoint respond successfully. Local tests and production builds pass. Database persistence and the complete connected workflow remain unverified; required credentials and submission artifacts are still pending.
authorship: Prepared with ChatGPT/Codex assistance. Shared Next.js/workspace infrastructure originates in code-up-matrix/axios-fx-compliance-agent; the product module was developed on 27 October 2026. Shared code must be disclosed under the event’s reuse rules.
eligibility: Working YouCam integration and e-commerce value; source and one-to-three-minute video. Actual API execution still pending.
judgeAccessInstructions: Provide the private judging access code through the submission portal after live verification. Do not put it in public source.
challenges: An upload URL must not become a credential leak or allow another workspace to reuse an asset. The local suite checks token ownership, permitted provider hosts and the actual cloth-v4 request shape.
accomplishments: The standalone build and eight tests pass. No real image rendering, provider task success or live end-to-end result is claimed yet.
lessons: Deleting a local receipt and deleting a provider-held image are different operations. A visual preview also does not establish physical fit.
next: Use an authorized YouCam key and permitted test images to verify a complete live render, task failure handling and local deletion, then record a one-to-three-minute demonstration.
judgeFit: Applies YouCam to a defined e-commerce decision and makes the task auditable. Actual cloth-v4 execution is mandatory evidence before entry.
demo: Explain the garment decision and label the permitted test photos.
Give consent, upload and create a real YouCam task.
